description: Create a photo ID badge with name, role, ID number and company branding — rendered as a printable badge.

faqs.a: The badge is rendered at 640 × 1000 px PNG, a standard vertical badge ratio.
The striped code at the bottom is decorative artwork, not a real scannable code.
For novelty, events, cosplay and mockups. Don't use it to impersonate staff or gain access anywhere.
faqs.q: Can I use it as a real staff ID?

howto: Upload a headshot photo for the badge.
Type the name, role, ID number and company.
Click "Download badge" to save the PNG.
title: ID Badge Maker
